Neither module is the machine the tick runs.

CardISA holds the instruction set of docs/SPEC-ISA.md: one Wait over an operand, and a result per kind, with three reversed witnesses. lifecycle.go still releases a sentinel on its own move, so the running waits are not that one action. The stale note on the sprint models does not cover this module; the running lifecycle is still the six states.

A card's attempts, the generation a move writes, and the epoch a clear advances are in the store. Land models the epoch only as the lander reads it, and EpochMemberTable is the table layer's epoch, not the sprint's. No module holds this machine.

The code asks a card's reads together, and ReadCards has never been checked. The code counts a re-ask when the reader hands the read back, draws a read from the tier's index, and keeps a begun read on a reader that went away (tla/README.md).

Land holds the batch, the check of the caller's epoch before any git, the report fenced to the epoch land read, a refusal of the card's own head reworking it (or reviewing it at its bound) with the stream going on and the lander's own failure stopping it (2026-10-06), and seven reversed witnesses. land.go still does that check. Catalog rows and generated ledgers regenerated inside a batch, and the ancestry check named by land-verify-landed-ancestry, are not in the module. LandPass holds the pass over several streams (2026-10-07): the merges in parallel up to a width, the landings one at a time in priority order, a pushed tip that passed its own gate, the combined gate, or a clean merge of disjoint files, a landing never lost by the merge after, a collision refusal that stops no stream, a tip recorded as gated only when a gate saw its whole tree (the next pass gates a disjoint merge), a re-merge that merges fewer heads or none, with six reversed witnesses and the liveness that with every tree green every batch lands; landpass.go runs those two phases. Since 2026-10-10 the landings go as each batch is built (NoHeadOfLine, the inorder witness), each stream's deadline on its own clock from its slot, and LandBisect holds a red batch's blame by bisection (at most ceil(log2 n) gates, a bench fault blaming no head), with three reversed witnesses.

SeatHealth holds the seat generation and a friend's health: a proof dated after the server clock is refused, and six reversed witnesses. seat.go and friend_health.go have not changed since the module.
A held card or member, a sentinel, and a stopped stream have no module of their own. CardISA folds those waits into one Wait and is not this machine.

SprintRules holds twins, the attempt bounds, the read-broken rule (rework or twin wider, left at the brief's bound), the harness-fault rework and the late report that finishes a failed attempt (Part answers), the late rule, the base gate and the idle alarm, in the same commit as the late-rule code; Part episodes holds a hard pin released past its bound (stops.go PinReleased), the cannot-ask judgment once a wait, and a rule's answer consumed by the attempt it started (2026-10-10). The judgments the tick raises, and the answers to them, are not in the module.

Level holds the machine rebalance at the start of a tick: levelTo, a gap of at least two, both end guards, and five reversed witnesses. steps_work.go cites the module. Friend level in internal/sprint/friend_level.go, within a class, and the readers' level are outside the module, which says the readers' level is not modelled. No card named for this map owes friend level, so it is named here rather than as a row with an empty owed_by. The avoid set also holds bench and launch refusals, and the callers are the level op and fleet up's comeUp.

RouteIndex holds the counter, a redeal and a pinned card, and checks a read with one draw and no redeal. The code also draws a read from the reader tier's index beside work cards (tla/README.md), and a route whose first flag is set deals before the others.

ServerLanes holds the one line of control and the beat and read lanes, with three reversed witnesses. servelanes.go still cites GoneNeverRuns. A later edit only lets a friend beat carry the flags of its report; the lane machine is unchanged.
check.go computes violations from a snapshot, so a break is found. Nothing in this tree stores a violation as found, then answered, then cleared, and no module holds that lifecycle.

WorkImport holds an issue under import and a repository's sync, with five reversed witnesses. Later refusals, an org-wide dry run, an existing output directory, and a verify of two trees, are command guards and not new states of that machine.

DirtyTick holds the tick as shaped on 2026-09-30. The code deals up to twice a member's width and rebalances the fleet table and the readers table at the start of every tick, and the model has no such step (tla/README.md).

CoordinatorWake holds the cursor written before the wake line, and a cursor that does not skip an event, with two reversed witnesses, in the same commit as watchwake.go. One cursor stands for the per-kind cursors, as the module says. The code has not changed since.

NoRoom holds a member's word from Room every tick (draining or not), its beat to the store, and the two planners that read it: the tick's deal and the fleet verbs outside the tick; and the drain the beat says (--draining, Beat.Draining): no deal to a draining member, its dealt cards not taken returned by the level, and a reader row's machine (held or draining) asked nothing, its reads asked and not begun taken back. Eight reversed witnesses (drainskip, fleetblind, tickblind, drainblind, readblind, silentdrain, noreturn, noreadreturn). The word's staleness (NoRoomNow on a beat's age), a reader's own drain (modelled as its machine's) and the read ask's reader states are outside the module.

RetireAbsent holds the tick's retirement of a fleet row whose machine record is gone from the inventory: sprint.TickRetireAbsent plans the fleet sync's own removal before the deal (internal/sprint/fleet_retire.go), the store's tick reads the inventory (cmd/nova-sprint/fleetsync.go inventoryMachines -> store.Inventory -> config.Widths, no new store) and deletes the row and the reader reader-<old> DropMembers returned after the answered read (internal/sprint/store/tick.go). RecordsKeepRows is the state invariant (a recorded machine keeps its row) and FleetRowsMatchConfig/LiveRetire the leads-to that the tick closes the gap. One reversed witness: MCRetireAbsentBroken retires a recorded row on a failed read, the counterexample to RecordsKeepRows.

The requests-per-minute window per model and the concurrency leases per provider, taken by every caller through the server before each model request (WATCH/MULTI, no scripts): NeverOverRate, NeverOverConcurrent, InFlightHeld, Progress, StalledIsGranted (bounded demand), SlotReclaimed; reversed witnesses race (an unguarded write), norenew, noexpiry. The deal-side fallback and the take gate count fleet cards (Go tests, internal/sprint/rate_budget_test.go), not this module.

RoadmapEntry holds an entry of docs/roadmap.sexp and docs/fixes.sexp under add, remove, pull and done: every group and release keeps an entry, every entry names one that is there, done is final, a shipped release is frozen, and a pull across the files writes the destination first, with four reversed witnesses.

SeatHook holds the server-owned subscription, the challenge answered over it, the cadence and its bound, delivery and acknowledgement, drop, unhook and the gate, with seven reversed witnesses, in the same commit as hook.go. It leaves out the replacement of an open hook (an end and a hook) and the cumulative ack, as its header says.

LiveRuns (v1.2.6, 2026-10-10) holds working against the rows' live sets, RUNNING and STOPPED: the tick's reconcile returns a working card its row's live set has not named for the grace (WorkingIsLive), a STOP debt entry owns its card only until its return receipt (StopMarkerIsWorking, OwnedLeavesWithReceipt), a held finished report is never returned and does not hold the start back (NoReportLost), and a running child's card is never returned (NoRunReturned), and a return settles its entry off the debt so clear reads a debt that is owed alone (DebtIsOwed); five reversed witnesses (the v1.2.5 STOPPED tick, the debt by id, a live set without held reports, a stale beat read as an empty set, a reconcile that leaves its receipt in the debt) and one reachability case. The friend daemon's live set is nova-friend's (nova-tools) and is not in this tree.
